root.label: Memphis immigration court reopens Aminata Seck case

events.label: Memphis immigration court reopens Aminata Seck case

slots.name: court appearance date
slots.sentence: Seck’s appearance in immigration court is set for Nov. 20.

slots.name: removal notice date
slots.sentence: In granting the motion, the judge found that Seck had demonstrated that she did not receive the notice of removal that the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said it served on Sept. 8, 2025.

slots.name: habeas petition status
slots.sentence: The ruling by the judge in Memphis paves the way for Seck to present her case through the immigration process, and her petition for a writ of habeas corpus remains pending in federal court in the Western District of Kentucky.
